result.instructions: Tools for Appstle, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which subscriptions are due to bill next week?"; "Show the subscriptions of customer 1234567890 and their upcoming orders."; "Skip the next order of subscription contract 987654321.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Appstle data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run appstle_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run appstle_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run appstle_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. appstle_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: appstle_list_subscription_contracts
tools.title: List subscription contracts
tools.description: List the store's subscription contracts with optional filters: status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, FAILED), customer name, order name, next billing date window, product or variant. Paged (page from 0, size up to 50). GET /subscription-contract-details.

next_billing_from.description: ISO 8601 date-time: next billing on or after this time.

next_billing_to.description: ISO 8601 date-time: next billing on or before this time.

tools.name: appstle_get_contract_analytics
tools.title: Get contract analytics
tools.description: Revenue and cycle metrics for one subscription contract. GET /subscription-contract-details/analytics/{contractId}.

contract_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

tools.name: appstle_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers with subscriptions
tools.description: List customers who have subscriptions, filtered by name or email, optionally only customers with more than one active subscription. Paged (page from 0, size up to 50). GET /subscription-contract-details/customers.

more_than_one_active.description: Only customers with more than one active subscription.

tools.name: appstle_get_customer_subscriptions
tools.title: Get a customer's subscriptions
tools.description: Detailed subscription information for one Shopify customer id. GET /subscription-customers-detail/valid/{customerId}.

customer_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

tools.name: appstle_get_upcoming_orders
tools.title: Get upcoming orders
tools.description: The next upcoming orders for a contract or a customer (give one of the two ids). GET /subscription-billing-attempts/top-orders.

contract_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

customer_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

tools.name: appstle_list_past_orders
tools.title: List past orders
tools.description: Past billing attempts and orders for a contract or a customer (give one of the two ids). Paged (page from 0, size up to 50). GET /subscription-billing-attempts/past-orders.

contract_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

customer_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

tools.name: appstle_list_subscription_groups
tools.title: List subscription groups
tools.description: All subscription groups (selling plan groups) of the store, with their plans and product counts. GET /subscription-groups.

tools.name: appstle_get_subscription_group
tools.title: Get a subscription group
tools.description: One subscription group by id, with its plans and assigned products. GET /subscription-groups/{id}.

group_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

tools.name: appstle_skip_next_order
tools.title: Skip the next order
tools.description: Skip the next upcoming order of a subscription contract. Each call skips the order after that, so a repeat call is not safe to retry. Reversible with appstle_unskip_order. PUT /subscription-billing-attempts/skip-upcoming-order.

contract_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

tools.name: appstle_unskip_order
tools.title: Unskip an order
tools.description: Undo a skipped order (billing attempt id from appstle_get_upcoming_orders). PUT /subscription-billing-attempts/unskip-order/{id}.

billing_attempt_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

contract_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

tools.name: appstle_set_next_billing_date
tools.title: Set the next billing date
tools.description: Move the next billing date of a subscription contract to a date-time (ISO 8601). Set reschedule_future_order to also move later orders. PUT /subscription-contracts-update-billing-date.

contract_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

tools.name: appstle_update_delivery_interval
tools.title: Change the delivery interval
tools.description: Set how often a subscription contract delivers, for example every 2 MONTH. PUT /subscription-contracts-update-delivery-interval.

contract_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

tools.name: appstle_set_contract_status
tools.title: Pause or resume a subscription
tools.description: Set a subscription contract to ACTIVE (resume) or PAUSED (pause). To cancel, use appstle_cancel_contract. PUT /subscription-contracts-update-status.

contract_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

tools.name: appstle_cancel_contract
tools.title: Cancel a subscription
tools.description: Cancel a subscription contract for good. Pending orders are cancelled and the plan's minimum billing cycles are enforced. Give an optional reason and note. DELETE /subscription-contracts/{id}.

contract_id.description: Numeric Appstle id (for example the subscription contract id, 123456789).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Appstle
prompts.description: What you can do with Appstle here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_which_subscriptions_bill_next_week
prompts.title: Check which subscriptions bill next week
prompts.description: List the subscription contracts with a next billing date in a window. Then read the upcoming orders of each contract.

prompts.name: review_one_customer_s_subscriptions_and_orders
prompts.title: Review one customer's subscriptions and orders
prompts.description: Search the customers who have subscriptions. Then read the subscriptions and the past orders of one customer.

prompts.name: read_the_revenue_and_cycle_metrics_of_a_contract
prompts.title: Read the revenue and cycle metrics of a contract
prompts.description: Get the revenue and cycle metrics of one subscription contract. Then read the subscription groups and their plans.

prompts.name: skip_or_unskip_the_next_order_of_a_subscription
prompts.title: Skip or unskip the next order of a subscription
prompts.description: Skip the next upcoming order of a subscription contract. Undo a skipped order with its billing attempt id.

prompts.name: move_a_billing_date_or_pause_a_subscription
prompts.title: Move a billing date or pause a subscription
prompts.description: Move the next billing date of a contract, change its delivery interval, or set the contract to ACTIVE or PAUSED.

prompts.name: cancel_a_subscription_for_good
prompts.title: Cancel a subscription for good
prompts.description: Cancel a subscription contract with an optional reason and note. Pending orders are cancelled too.
